pairs.fullEnglish: And יְיָ said to Avrum: Go from your land, from your birthplace, and from your father's house, to the land that I will show you.
And I will make you into a numerous people, and I will bless you and make your name great, and you shall be blessed.
And I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all the families of the earth shall be blessed on your account.
And Avrum went as יְיָ had spoken with him, and Lot went with him. And Avrum was seventy-five years old when he departed from חָרָן.

And Avrum took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their possessions that they had acquired, and the persons whom they had brought into service of the Torah in חָרָן. And they went out to go to the land of כְּנַעַן, and they came to the land of כְּנָעַן.
And Avrum passed through the land as far as the place of שְׁכֶם, as far as the plain of מוֹרֶה; and the Canaanites were then in the land.
And יְיָ was revealed to Avrum and said: To your children I will give this land. And he built an altar there before יְיָ, who had been revealed to him.
And he went up from there to the mountain east of Bais El, and spread his tent, with Bais El to the west and עַי to the east. And he built an altar there before יְיָ, and prayed in the name of יְיָ.
And Avrum journeyed, going on and journeying toward the south.
And there was famine in the land, and Avrum went down to Egypt to reside there, because the famine in the land was severe.
And it will be, when the Egyptians see you, that they will say: This is his wife. And they will kill me, but you they will keep alive.
Say now that you are my sister, so that it may go well with me on your account, and my life may be preserved through your words.
And it happened, when Avrum entered Egypt, that the Egyptians saw the woman, that she was very beautiful.
And Pharaoh's officials saw her and praised her to Pharaoh, and the woman was taken to Pharaoh's house.
And יְיָ brought great afflictions upon Pharaoh and upon the people of his house because of the matter of Sarai, Avrum's wife.
And Pharaoh called Avrum and said: What is this that you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she is your wife?
Why did you say: She is my sister, so that I took her for myself as a wife? And now, here is your wife; take her and go.
And Pharaoh gave men orders concerning him, and they escorted him and his wife and everything that was his.
And Avrum went up from Egypt, he and his wife and everything that was his, and Lot with him, toward the south.
And Avrum was very wealthy in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
And he went on his journeys from the south as far as Bais El, to the place where he had spread his tent at first, between Bais El and עָי.
To the place of the altar that he had made there at first; and there Avrum prayed in the name of יְיָ.
And the land could not sustain them dwelling together, because their possessions were numerous, and they were unable to dwell together.
And there was strife between the herdsmen of Avrum's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock; and the Canaanites and the Perizzites were then dwelling in the land.
Is not the whole land before you? Separate now from me: if you go north, then I will go south; and if you go south, then I will go north.

And Lot lifted his eyes and saw the whole plain of the Jordan, that all of it was irrigated land, before יְיָ destroyed סְדוֹם and עֲמֹרָה, like the garden of יְיָ, like the land of Egypt, extending to צֹעַר.
Avrum dwelt in the land of כְּנָעַן, and Lot dwelt in the towns of the plain, and spread his tent as far as סְדוֹם.
And the people of סְדוֹם were evil with their wealth and exceedingly guilty with their bodies before יְיָ.
And יְיָ said to Avrum after Lot had separated from him: Lift your eyes now, and look from the place where you are, to the north and to the south and to the east and to the west.
For all the land that you see, to you I will give it and to your children forever.
And I will make your children numerous like the dust of the earth: just as it is not possible for a man to count the dust of the earth, so too your children will not be counted.
Arise, walk through the land, along its length and its breadth, for to you I will give it.
And Avrum spread his tent, and came and dwelt in the plains of מַמְרֵא that are in חֶבְרוֹן, and built an altar there before יְיָ.
And it happened in the days of אַמְרָפֶל king of Babylon, אַרְיוֹךְ king of אֶלָּסָר, כְּדָרְלָעֹמֶר king of עֵילָם, and תִדְעָל king of peoples:
All these assembled at the plain of the fields; it is the site of the Salt Sea.

And in the fourteenth year כְּדָרְלָעֹמֶר came, and the kings with him, and they struck the mighty men who were in עַשְׁתְּרוֹת קַרְנַיִם, and the strong men who were in הֶמְתָּא, and the fearsome men who were in שָׁוֵה קִרְיָתָיִם.
And the Horites who were in their mountain of שֵׂעִיר, as far as the plain of פָּארָן, which adjoins the wilderness.

And the king of סְדוֹם went out, and the king of עֲמוֹרָה, and the king of אַדְמָה, and the king of צְבוֹיִם, and the king of בֶלַע, which is צוֹעַר; and they arrayed for battle against them in the plain of the fields.
Against כְּדָרְלָעֹמֶר king of עֵילָם, and תִדְעָל king of peoples, and אַמְרָפֶל king of Babylon, and אַרְיוֹךְ king of אֶלָּסָר: four kings against five.
And the plain of the fields had pits upon pits yielding bitumen; and the kings of סְדוֹם and עֲמוֹרָה fled and fell there, and those who remained fled to the mountain.
And they took captive all the possessions of סְדוֹם and עֲמוֹרָה, and all their food, and went away.
And they took captive Lot, Avrum's brother's son, and his possessions, and went away; and he was dwelling in סְדוֹם.
And the one who had escaped came and told Avrum the Hebrew; and he was staying in the plains of מַמְרֵא the Amorite, brother of אֶשְׁכּוֹל and brother of עָנֵר, and they were men of Avrum's covenant.
And he split up against them by night, he and his servants, and they struck them and pursued them as far as חוֹבָה, which is north of Damascus.
And he brought back all the possessions; and he also brought back Lot, his brother's son, and his possessions, and also the women and the people.
And the king of סְדוֹם said to Avrum: Give me the persons, and take the possessions for yourself.
Except for what the young men have eaten, and the share of the men who went with me, עָנֵר, אֶשְׁכֹּל, and מַמְרֵא: they shall receive their share.
After these things, the word of יְיָ was with Avrum in prophecy, saying: Do not fear, Avrum; My Word is strength for you; your reward is very great.
And Avrum said: Behold, to me You have not given a child, and behold, a member of my household will inherit from me.
And behold, the word of יְיָ was with him, saying: This one will not inherit from you; rather, a son whom you will beget, he will inherit from you.
And He brought him outside and said: Look now toward the heavens, and count the stars, if you are able to count them. And He said to him: So shall your children be.
And He said to him: I am יְיָ, who brought you out from the fire of the Chaldeans, to give you this land to inherit it.
And he said: יְיָ אֱלֹּהִים, by what shall I know that I will inherit it?
And He said to him: Offer before Me three calves, and three goats, and three rams, and a turtledove and a young pigeon.
And he offered all these before Him, and divided them equally, and placed the halves, each half opposite its counterpart; but the birds he did not divide.
And birds came down upon the carcasses, and Avrum drove them to flight.
And the sun was about to set, and sleep fell upon Avrum; and behold, terror of great darkness fell upon him.
And He said to Avrum: You shall surely know that your children will be sojourners in a land that is not theirs, and they will enslave them and afflict them for four hundred years.
And I will also judge the people who will enslave them; and afterward they will go out with many possessions.
And you shall enter into the company of your fathers in peace; you shall be buried in good old age.
And the fourth generation shall return here, for the guilt of the Amorites has not been completed up to now.
And the sun had set and there was darkness; and behold, a furnace of smoke and a blaze of fire that passed between these halves.
On that day יְיָ concluded a covenant with Avrum, saying: To your children I have given this land, from the river of Egypt as far as the great river, the river פְּרָת:
The שַׁלְמָאֵי, and the קְנִזָּאֵי, and the קַדְמוֹנָאֵי;
And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the mighty ones;
And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
And Sarai, Avrum's wife, had not borne him a child; and she had an Egyptian maidservant, and her name was Hagar.
And Sarai said to Avrum: Behold now, יְיָ has prevented me from bearing; go in now to my maidservant, perhaps I may be built up through her. And Avrum accepted Sarai's word.
And Sarai, Avrum's wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her maidservant, at the end of ten years of Avrum's dwelling in the land of כְּנָעַן, and gave her to Avrum her husband, to be his wife.
And he went in to Hagar, and she conceived; and she saw that she had conceived, and her mistress became of little account in her eyes.
And Sarai said to Avrum: I have a case against you. I gave you my maidservant, and she saw that she had conceived, and I became of little account in her eyes. May יְיָ judge between me and you.
And Avrum said to Sarai: Behold, your maidservant is in your hand; do to her as is proper in your eyes. And Sarai afflicted her, and she fled from before her.
And an angel of יְיָ found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to חַגְרָא.
And the angel of יְיָ said to her: Return to your mistress, and subject yourself under her hands.
And the angel of יְיָ said to her: I will surely multiply your children, and they will not be counted because of their multitude.
And the angel of יְיָ said to her: Behold, you are pregnant, and you will bear a son, and you shall call his name יִשְׁמָעֵאל, because יְיָ has accepted your prayer.
And Hagar bore Avrum a son, and Avrum called the name of his son whom Hagar had borne יִשְׁמָעֵאל.
And Avrum was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore יִשְׁמָעֵאל to Avrum.
And Avrum was ninety-nine years old, and יְיָ was revealed to Avrum and said to him: I am אֵל שַׁדַּי; serve before Me and be whole.
And I will place My covenant between My Word and you, and I will multiply you very, very greatly.
And Avrum fell upon his face, and יְיָ spoke with him, saying:
And your name shall no longer be called Avrum, but your name shall be Avraham, for I have made you a father of many peoples.
And I will make you very, very numerous, and I will make you into congregations; and kings who rule among the peoples shall come forth from you.
And I will establish My covenant between My Word and you and your children after you, throughout their generations, as an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your children after you.
And I will give to you and to your children after you the land of your residence, the whole land of כְּנַעַן, as an everlasting possession, and I will be God to them.
And יְיָ said to Avraham: And you shall keep My covenant, you and your children after you throughout their generations.
This is My covenant that you shall keep between My Word and you and your children after you: to circumcise every male among you.
And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be a sign of a covenant between My Word and you.
And an uncircumcised male who does not circumcise the flesh of his foreskin—that person shall be destroyed from his people; he has altered My covenant.
And יְיָ said to Avraham: Sarai your wife—you shall not call her name Sarai, for Sarah is her name.
And I will bless her, and I will also give you a son from her, and I will bless her and she shall become congregations; kings who rule among the peoples shall come from her.
And Avraham fell upon his face and rejoiced, and said in his heart: Will a man a hundred years old have a child? And if Sarah has become ninety years old, will she give birth?
And Avraham said before יְיָ: If only יִשְׁמָעֵאל might be preserved before You!
And יְיָ said: In truth, Sarah your wife will bear you a son, and you shall call his name יִצְחָק; and I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his children after him.

And concerning יִשְׁמָעֵאל, I have accepted your prayer. Behold, I have blessed him, and I will make him numerous and multiply him very, very greatly. He shall beget twelve rulers, and I will make him into a numerous people.
And My covenant I will establish with יִצְחָק, whom Sarah will bear to you at this appointed time in the next year.
And He finished speaking with him, and the glory of יְיָ ascended from above Avraham.

And Avraham took יִשְׁמָעֵאל his son, and all those born in his house, and all those bought with his money, every male among the people of Avraham's house; and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskins on that very day, as יְיָ had spoken with him.
And it happened, when he drew near to enter Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife: Behold, now I know that you are a woman beautiful in appearance.

qualifications.he: האנגלית מתרגמת את הנוסח הראשי ״כד״: ״כאשר״. בסוגריים מובאת החלופה ״ארי״: ״כי/מפני ש־״, המקשרת את הקרבה למצרים בקשר סיבתי במקום בקשר זמן. שני הנוסחים נשמרים במקור; התרגום אינו קובע איזו מהדורה עדיפה.
qualifications.en: The English translates the main reading כַּד, 'when.' The parenthesized alternative אַרֵי means 'for/because' and makes the approach to Egypt a causal rather than a temporal connection. Both readings remain in the source; this translation does not establish the priority of an edition.

pairs.fullEnglish: And he treated Avrum well on her account, and he had flocks, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
And Lot too, who went with Avrum, had flocks, cattle, and tents.
And Avrum said to Lot: Let there now be no strife between me and you, or between my herdsmen and your herdsmen, for we are men who are brothers.

qualifications.he: כאן נאמר ״אנשים אחים אנחנו״, ואילו ב־12:5 לוט נקרא בן אחיו של אברם. האנגלית משמרת את לשון הקרבה שבכל מקום; ״אחים״ כאן אינו קביעה שהם אחים ביולוגיים, ואינו מוחלף ב״דוד ואחיין״.
qualifications.en: Here the source says 'we are men who are brothers,' whereas 12:5 calls Lot Avrum's brother's son. The English preserves each passage's kinship wording. 'Brothers' here does not assert that they are biological brothers, and it is not replaced by 'uncle and nephew.'

pairs.fullEnglish: They arrayed for battle against בֶּרַע king of סְדֹם, and against בִּרְשַׁע king of עֲמֹרָה, שִׁנְאָב king of אַדְמָה, and שֶׁמְאֵבֶר king of צְבוֹיִם, and the king of בֶלַע, which is צֹעַר.

qualifications.he: האנגלית מתרגמת ״סדרו קרבא״: ״ערכו קרב״. החלופה שבסוגריים, ״עבדו קרבא״, היא ״עשו מלחמה״. אין מחיקה או החלפה של אחד מנוסחי המקור, ואין כאן הכרעה בעד מהדורה מסוימת.
qualifications.en: The English translates סְדָרוּ קְרָבָא, 'arrayed for battle.' The parenthesized alternative עֲבַדוּ קְרָבָא means 'made war.' Neither source reading is deleted or substituted, and no priority is assigned to an edition.

pairs.fullEnglish: For twelve years they served כְּדָרְלָעֹמֶר, and for thirteen years they rebelled.

qualifications.he: במקור כתוב ״ושלוש עשרה שנים מרדו״, בלי מילת היחס שבתחילת ציון הזמן ב־14:5. האנגלית משמרת כאן את לשון משך השנים ואינה מתקנת אותה ל״בשנה השלוש עשרה״. אין בכך הצעה ליישב את הכרונולוגיה או לשנות את נוסח הפסוק הבא.
qualifications.en: The source says 'and thirteen years they rebelled,' without the preposition introducing the time expression at 14:5. The English preserves the duration wording here rather than correcting it to 'in the thirteenth year.' This does not propose a harmonized chronology or change the following verse.

pairs.fullEnglish: And they returned and came to the plain of the division of judgment, which is רְקָם, and struck the whole field of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who dwelt in עֵין גֶּדִי.

qualifications.he: ״מישור חלוקת הדין״ מתרגם את לשון תיאור המקום שבמקור. אין בביטוי לבדו פירוט של הליך משפטי מסוים או של סיפור מקורו של השם. השם המקראי אינו מחליף כאן את תיאור התרגום, ואין זיהוי גאוגרפי נוסף.
qualifications.en: 'Plain of the division of judgment' translates the source's designation of the place. The expression alone does not specify a particular judicial procedure or the history behind the designation. No remembered biblical place-name replaces the Targum's description, and no additional geographical identification is asserted.

pairs.fullEnglish: And Avrum heard that his brother had been taken captive, and he readied his young men, those born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as דָּן.

qualifications.he: כאן נאמר ״נשבה אחיו״, וב־14:12 לוט נקרא בן אחיו של אברם. נשמר מונח הקרבה של הפסוק הזה בלי להחליפו ב״אחיינו״ ובלי להסיק ממנו שהם אחים ביולוגיים.
qualifications.en: This verse says 'his brother had been taken captive'; 14:12 calls Lot Avrum's brother's son. The present kinship term is retained rather than replaced by 'his nephew,' and does not imply that they are biological brothers.

pairs.fullEnglish: And the king of סְדוֹם went out to meet him after he returned from striking כְּדָרְלָעוֹמֶר and the kings who were with him, to the open plain, which is the site of the king's racecourse.

qualifications.he: האנגלית משמרת את תיאור המקום: מישור פנוי ומקום מסלול המרוצים של המלך. אין כאן טענה על מבנהו ההיסטורי המדויק של המתקן או על זיהויו כיום, ואין החלפה בשם העמק המקראי.
qualifications.en: The English preserves the description of an open plain and the site of the king's racecourse. It does not assert the facility's precise historical construction or identify a modern site, and it does not replace the description with the biblical valley-name.
qualifications.anchor: מֵישַׁר מַפְנָא הוּא אֲתַר בֵּית רֵיסָא דְמַלְכָּא

pairs.fullEnglish: And מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק, king of Jerusalem, brought out bread and wine, and he was ministering before God Most High.
And he blessed him and said: Blessed is Avrum by God Most High, to whom the heavens and the earth belong.
And blessed is God Most High, who delivered your enemies into your hand. And he gave him one out of ten of everything.

qualifications.he: משפט הנתינה אומר ״הוא נתן לו״ ואינו נוקב בשמות הנותן והמקבל. האנגלית שומרת על כינויי הגוף ועל ״אחד מעשרה מן הכול״; היא אינה מוסיפה זיהוי שמי שאינו מפורש במשפט.
qualifications.en: The giving clause says 'he gave him' without naming the giver and recipient. The English preserves these pronouns and 'one out of ten of everything'; it does not insert identities that the clause itself does not state.
qualifications.anchor: וִיהַב לֵיהּ חַד מִן עַסְרָא מִכֹּלָּא

pairs.fullEnglish: And Avrum said to the king of סְדוֹם: I have raised my hands in prayer before יְיָ, before God Most High, to whom the heavens and the earth belong:
If I take so much as a thread or a sandal strap, or if I take anything that is yours—! And you shall not say: I made Avrum rich.

qualifications.he: המקור מביע סירוב בלשון שבועה: ״אם... ואם אקח״, בלי לפרש את התוצאה של הפרת השבועה. האנגלית משאירה את משפט התנאי תלוי, כפי שמסומן בקו המפריד, ואינה מוסיפה עונש או מוחקת את מבנה התנאי.
qualifications.en: The source expresses refusal through an oath formula, 'if ... or if I take,' without stating the consequence of violating the oath. The English leaves that conditional suspended, indicated by the dash; it neither invents a penalty nor removes the conditional form.
qualifications.anchor: אִם מִחוּטָא וְעַד עַרְקַת מְסָנָא וְאִם אֶסַּב מִכָּל דִּי לָךְ

pairs.fullEnglish: And he trusted in the Word of יְיָ, and he reckoned it to him as merit.

qualifications.he: המשפט אינו נוקב בשם החושב, ומביע את מושא החשיבה ואת מקבלה בכינויי גוף. האנגלית משמרת ״הוא החשיב זאת לו לזכות״ בלי להוסיף שם לנושא או להכריע מה מציין ״זאת״. ״לזכו״ מתורגם ״לזכות״.
qualifications.en: The clause does not name the one who reckoned, and expresses what was reckoned and to whom by pronouns. The English retains 'he reckoned it to him as merit' without inserting a named subject or fixing the referent of 'it.' לְזָכוּ is rendered 'as merit.'

pairs.fullEnglish: And he said: Hagar, Sarai's maidservant, from where are you coming, and to where are you going? And she said: From before Sarai my mistress I am fleeing.

qualifications.he: הנוסח הראשי ״אנא ערקא״ הוא ״אני בורחת״. החלופה המנוקדת ״ערקת״ היא צורת עבר בגוף שלישי נקבה, ״היא ברחה״; כפי שנדפסה אין היא תחליף רגיל לעבר בגוף ראשון אחרי ״אנא״. האנגלית מתרגמת את הנוסח הראשי ואינה מתקנת בשתיקה את החלופה ל״אני ברחתי״.
qualifications.en: The main reading אֲנָא עָרְקָא means 'I am fleeing.' The pointed alternative עֲרָקַת is a third-feminine-singular past form, 'she fled'; as printed, it is not an ordinary first-person past replacement after אֲנָא, 'I.' The English translates the main reading and does not silently correct the alternative to 'I fled.'

pairs.fullEnglish: And he will be rebellious among men; he will be in need of everyone, and the hand of the sons of men will have need of him; and in the presence of all his brothers he will dwell.

qualifications.he: במקור כתוב ״וידא״, עם ״יד״ בלשון יחיד, ואחריו לשון רבים ״יהון צריכין ליה״. האנגלית שומרת על ״יד בני אדם״ ועל הצורך בו, בלי להחליף זאת ב״ידם נגדו״ ובלי להוסיף הסבר כלכלי או מלחמתי. ההקשר מציג צורך הדדי, אך אינו מפרש את דימוי היד.
qualifications.en: The source has וִידָא, with singular 'hand,' followed by plural יְהוֹן צְרִיכִין לֵיהּ, 'will have need of him.' The English preserves 'the hand of the sons of men' and the need of him, rather than substituting 'their hand against him' or adding an economic or military explanation. The context expresses mutual need but does not explain the hand image.
qualifications.anchor: וִידָא דִבְנֵי אֲנָשָׁא יְהוֹן צְרִיכִין לֵיהּ

pairs.fullEnglish: And at eight days old every male among you shall be circumcised throughout your generations, those born in the house and those bought with money from any member of the peoples who is not of your children.

qualifications.he: הנוסח הראשי ״יתגזר״ הוא סביל: ״יימול״. החלופה ״יגזר״ היא צורה פעילה: ״ימול״, ואינה נוקבת בשם העושה. האנגלית מתרגמת את הנוסח הראשי; היא אינה מאחדת את הבניינים ואינה ממנה מוהל מסוים לחלופה.
qualifications.en: The main reading יִתְגְּזַר is passive, 'shall be circumcised.' The alternative יִגְזַר is active, 'shall circumcise,' without naming an actor. The English translates the main reading; it neither equates the voices nor appoints a particular circumciser for the alternative.

pairs.fullEnglish: Those born in your house and those bought with your money shall surely be circumcised, and My covenant shall be in your flesh as an everlasting covenant.

qualifications.he: הנוסח הראשי מדגיש מילה בסביל ובלשון רבים: ״הימול יימולו״. החלופה ״מגזר יגזר״ היא פעילה ובלשון יחיד, בקירוב ״מול ימול״; היא אינה נוקבת בשם העושה. האנגלית משמרת את עיקר הנוסח הראשי ואינה מסיקה מן החלופה מי מבצע את המילה.
qualifications.en: The main reading emphatically expresses circumcision in the passive plural, 'shall surely be circumcised.' The alternative מִגְזַר יִגְזַר is active singular, approximately 'shall surely circumcise,' and does not name an actor. The English preserves the main reading and does not infer from the alternative who performs the circumcision.

pairs.fullEnglish: And Avraham was ninety-nine years old when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.

qualifications.he: ״גזר״ הוא פועל פעיל, ומשפט הזמן אינו מוסיף שם עצם לנושא. האנגלית משמרת ״כאשר הוא מל את בשר ערלתו״, בלי להוסיף ״בעצמו״ ובלי להפוך את הפועל לסביל. אין תוספת פרטים על אופן ביצוע הפעולה.
qualifications.en: גְּזַר is active, and the time clause does not add a noun naming its subject. The English retains 'when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin,' without adding an emphatic 'himself' or converting the verb to a passive. No additional details about the performance of the act are asserted.

pairs.fullEnglish: And יִשְׁמָעֵאל his son was thirteen years old when [Avraham] circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.

qualifications.he: השם ״אברהם״ שבסוגריים המרובעים נוסף באנגלית מן ההקשר המפורש ב־17:23, שבו אברהם מל את ישמעאל ואת זכרי ביתו; השם אינו כתוב מחדש במשפט הזמן כאן. נשמר הפועל הפעיל ״גזר״, ובשר הערלה הוא של ישמעאל. אין קביעה שישמעאל מל את עצמו.
qualifications.en: [Avraham] is supplied in English from the explicit context at 17:23, where Avraham circumcises יִשְׁמָעֵאל and the males of his household; the name is not repeated in this verse's time clause. The active גְּזַר is preserved, and the foreskin is יִשְׁמָעֵאל's. The wording does not assert that יִשְׁמָעֵאל circumcised himself.

pairs.fullEnglish: On that very day Avraham and יִשְׁמָעֵאל his son were circumcised.

qualifications.he: האנגלית מתרגמת את ״אתגזר״ שבנוסח הראשי בסביל: ״נימול״. החלופה ״גזר״ היא פעילה: ״מל״; אין בה מושא מפורש לפעולה במשפט הזה. ההבדל נשמר, ואין הפיכת שתי הצורות לטענה זהה או הוספת מושא לחלופה.
qualifications.en: The English renders the main reading אִתְגְּזַר passively, 'was circumcised.' The alternative גְּזַר is active, 'circumcised'; this clause does not state an object for that active action. The difference is retained rather than making both forms assert the same thing or supplying an object for the alternative.

pairs.fullEnglish: And all the men of his house, those born in the house and those bought with money from a member of the peoples, were circumcised with him.

qualifications.he: הנוסח הראשי ״אתגזרו עמיה״ הוא ״נימולו עמו״. החלופה ״גזרו״ היא פעילה בלשון רבים: ״מלו״; המשפט אינו מפרש את מושא הפעולה לפי החלופה. האנגלית מתרגמת את הנוסח הראשי, בלי למחוק את הבדל הבניין ובלי לקבוע את מי מלו לפי החלופה.
qualifications.en: The main reading אִתְגְּזָרוּ עִמֵּיהּ means 'were circumcised with him.' The alternative גְּזָרוּ is active plural, 'they circumcised'; the clause does not state the object of that alternative action. The English translates the main reading without erasing the difference in voice or deciding whom they circumcised under the alternative.

pairs.fullEnglish: Why do you say, Jacob, and declare, Israel, ‘My way is hidden from before יְיָ, and my judgment passes away from before my God’?

But those who have hoped for the deliverance of יְיָ will be gathered from the midst of their exile and will gain strength. They will be renewed in their youth, like the new growth that rises upon eagles’ wings. They will run and not become exhausted; they will walk and not grow weary.
Listen to My Word, islands, and let kingdoms gain strength. Let them draw near; then let them speak. Together let us draw near for judgment.
So walk in the ways of good people, and keep the paths of the righteous.
For the upright remain in the land, and those without blemish are left in it.
But the wicked will perish from the land, and plunderers will be uprooted from it.
My son, do not forget my teaching, and let your heart keep my commandments.
For length of days, years of life, and peace will be added to you.
Let kindness and truth not leave you. Bind them around your neck, and write them upon the tablet of your heart.

Who declared these things and fulfilled them, spoke and acted, and ordered the generations from of old? I, יְיָ, created the world from the beginning; the ages of ages, too, are Mine. Apart from Me there is no God.
The islands saw and will fear; those at the ends of the earth will tremble. They will draw near and come.
Place your hope in God with all your heart, and do not lean upon the understanding of your own heart.
In all your ways know Him, and He will make your paths straight.
Do not be wise in your own estimation; fear God and turn away from evil.
Each man will help his fellow, and will say to his brother, ‘Be strong!’
But you, Israel, My servant, Jacob, in whom I have taken pleasure, offspring of Abraham, My beloved—
Do not fear, for My Word is your support. Do not be broken, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will also help you; I will also uphold you with My right hand of truth.
Honor your God from your wealth and from the first of all your produce.
Then your storehouses will be filled with abundance, and your presses will overflow with wine.
For God disciplines the one He loves, as a father disciplines his son.
Behold, all the peoples who used to provoke you will be ashamed and humbled. The men who dispute your case will become as nothing and perish.
For I am יְיָ your God, who strengthens your right hand, who said to you, ‘Do not fear; My Word is your support.’
Do not fear, tribes of the house of Jacob, offspring of Israel. My Word is your support, says יְיָ, and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away. His Word will scatter them as a whirlwind scatters straw. But you will rejoice in the Word of יְיָ; in the Holy One of Israel you will glory.
Happy is the person who has found wisdom, and the person who brings forth understanding.
For its trade is better than trade in silver, and its yield is better than refined gold.
It is more precious than precious stones, and nothing at all compares to it.
Length of days is in its right hand; in its left are wealth and honor.
Its ways are ways of pleasantness, and all its paths are peace.
It is a tree of life to those who hold fast to it, and happy are those who occupy themselves with it.

The humble and needy who long for instruction are, behold, like those who thirst for water and cannot find it; their spirit grows weary through affliction. I, יְיָ, will receive their prayer; I, the God of Israel, will not put them far away.
So that they may see and know, set the fear of Me upon their hearts, and understand together that the might of יְיָ has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
God founded the earth with wisdom and established the heavens with understanding.
And they will be life for your soul and grace for your neck.
Then you will walk with hope in your ways, and your foot will not stumble.
Have you not known, or have you not heard? יְיָ is the eternal God, who created the foundations of the earth, not with toil and not with weariness. There is no end to His understanding.

Who openly brought Abraham from the east, the chosen one of the righteous, and in truth brought him near to his place? He delivered peoples before him and shattered mighty kings. He cast down slain men like dust before his sword, and fugitives like straw before his bow.

qualifications.he: בגלאי מתורגם 'בגלוי'; אין כאן פועל מפורש האומר שהאל גילה את עצמו. כינוי השייכות באתריה נשמר כ'מקומו', בלי להכריע אם המקום מיוחס למקרב או לאברהם ובלי להוסיף זיהוי למקום. אברהם מזוהה במפורש כבחיר הצדיקים.
qualifications.en: בגלאי is rendered 'openly'; the clause does not explicitly say that God revealed Himself. The possessive in באתריה remains 'his place,' without deciding whether the place belongs to the One bringing Abraham near or to Abraham, and without adding a location. Abraham is explicitly identified as the chosen one of the righteous.
qualifications.anchor: אַיְתֵי בִגְלַאי מִמַדִינְחָא אַבְרָהָם בְּחִיר צַדִיקַיָא בִּקְשׁוֹט קַרְבֵהּ לְאַתְרֵהּ

pairs.fullEnglish: you whom I brought near from the earth’s offspring and chose from among the kingdoms, and to whom I said, ‘You are My servant; I have taken pleasure in you and have not put you far away.’
Behold, I have made you all into a strong, new threshing sledge, full of spikes. You will kill the worshipers of the stars and destroy them, and you will make the kingdom like chaff.

qualifications.he: 'זיזים חדים' הוא תיאור כללי של החלקים הבולטים במורג. אין בכך קביעה על צורתם המדויקת, על החומר שממנו נעשו או על מבנה המורג, ואין החלפה אוטומטית שלהם בשיניים על פי הפסוק העברי.
qualifications.en: 'Spikes' is a broad description of the threshing implement's projecting points. It does not determine their exact shape, material, or the implement's construction, and it does not automatically substitute the Hebrew verse's teeth.

pairs.fullEnglish: By His knowledge the depths were split open, and the heavens shed dew.

qualifications.he: השמים הם הנזכרים כאן כמוציאים טל. הניסוח 'ממטירים טל' משמש כתיאור כללי של נתינת הטל, בלי לקבוע מנגנון פיזי או להכריע בין טפטוף, הזלפה ופיזור, ובלי להחליף את השמים בעננים.
qualifications.en: The heavens are what the clause names as shedding dew. 'Shed dew' describes the giving forth of dew broadly, without determining a physical mechanism or choosing among dripping, sprinkling, and scattering, and without replacing the heavens with clouds.

pairs.fullEnglish: He gives wisdom to the righteous who grow weary for the words of Torah, and He increases possessions for those who have no strength.

qualifications.he: התרגום קושר את לאות הצדיקים לדברי תורה ומייחס להם נתינת חכמה. הלשון אינה מפרטת כאן אם הלאות נובעת ממאמץ בלימוד או מכיסופים לדברי תורה; הניסוח משמר את הזיקה בלי להוסיף סיבה מסוימת.
qualifications.en: The Targum connects the righteous people's weariness with the words of Torah and speaks of wisdom given to them. The wording does not specify here whether that weariness comes from exertion in study or from longing for the words of Torah; the translation preserves the connection without adding a particular cause.

pairs.fullEnglish: He pursued them and passed on in peace; the weariness of the road did not enter his feet.
My son, do not despise God's discipline, and do not loathe His rebuke.
I will place cedars, acacias, myrtles, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will cause the trees called בּוּרְוָן, מוּרְנְיָן, and אֶשְׁכְּרוֹעִין to grow together in the plain.

qualifications.he: עצי שמן נשמרים כתיאור שבמקור, בלי לקבוע שמדובר בזיתים. שמות העצים בורון, מורנין ואשכרועין נשמרים בלשון שסופקה, ולא נקבע כאן זיהוים כמינים בוטניים מודרניים. הרשימה מבחינה בין העצים ומתארת את גידולם יחד במישור; אין קביעה שכל אחד מן השמות הוא דווקא ברוש, מילה או תאשור.
qualifications.en: 'Oil trees' retains the source's description without identifying olives. The tree names בורון, מורנין, and אשכרועין are retained as supplied rather than assigned precise modern botanical species. The list distinguishes the trees and describes their growth together in the plain; it does not establish that these names mean, respectively, cypress, ash, and box trees.
qualifications.anchor: וְאָעִין דִמְשַׁח אֱרַבֵּי בְמֵישְׁרָא בּוּרְוָן מוּרְנְיָן וְאֶשְׁכְּרוֹעִין כַּחֲדָא

pairs.fullEnglish: My son, let it not be of little worth in your eyes; preserve knowledge and thought.

qualifications.he: מושא האזהרה שלא להקל בערכו אינו נקוב במפורש, ולכן הניסוח אינו מוסיף לו שם מסוים. תרעיתא מתורגמת 'מחשבה', בלי לקבוע שמדובר בעצה, בכוונה או במהלך שיקול דעת מסוים. האזהרה נשמרת כלשון הערכה 'בעיניך', ולא מוחלפת בנוסח העברי על הסתלקות מן העיניים.
qualifications.en: The object that is not to be held of little worth is not expressly named, so 'it' does not supply a particular noun. תרעיתא is rendered broadly as 'thought,' without deciding that it means a specific counsel, intention, or process of deliberation. The warning retains the valuation idiom 'in your eyes' rather than substituting a Hebrew departure-from-sight clause.
qualifications.anchor: בְּרִי לָא נִזַל בְּעֵינָךְ נְטַר מַדְעָא וְתַרְעִיתָא

pairs.fullEnglish: Guilty youths will grow weary and become exhausted, and wicked young men will surely stumble.
And you will find favor, understanding, and goodwill before God and before human beings.
You will seek them and will not find them—the men who contend with you. The men who used to stir up conflict to make war against you will become as nothing, as nothing at all.
Bring your case near, says יְיָ; bring forward what you have to show, says the King of Jacob.

qualifications.he: הלשון מתארת הבאת הדברים שיש להציג, במסגרת הזימון להביא את הדין. אין היא קובעת כאן אם המוצג הוא חזון נבואי, מראה או דבר המובא להוכחה.
qualifications.en: The wording describes bringing forward what one has to show, within the summons to present a case. It does not determine here whether the presentation is a prophetic vision, a sight, or something offered as evidence.

pairs.fullEnglish: And she prayed in the name of יְיָ, who was speaking with her; she said: You are God, who sees all. For she said: Have I indeed here (<small>variant</small> have I too) begun to see after he was revealed to me?

qualifications.he: שָׁרֵתִי עם חָזְיָא נקרא כאן כצירוף של התחלת פעולה: 'התחלתי לראות'. הַבְרַם הָכָא נשמר כשאלה מודגשת על הראייה כאן; החלופה הַאַף אֲנָא מתורגמת 'האם גם אני'. בָּתַר נשמר כיחס של זמן, ומי שנתגלה נשאר בכינוי בלבד. אין תוספת של 'רק כאן', של הישרדות לאחר הראייה או של זהות מפורשת למתגלה. פירוש רש״י להגם הלם עוסק בראיית שלוחים גם קודם לכן, אך אינו פירוש מילוני ישיר לצירוף הארמי.
qualifications.en: שָׁרֵתִי with חָזְיָא is read here as an inceptive construction, 'I began to see.' הַבְרַם הָכָא remains an emphatic question about seeing here; the alternative הַאַף אֲנָא is rendered 'have I too.' בָּתַר retains its temporal relation, and the one revealed remains a pronoun. The translation adds neither 'only here,' survival after seeing, nor an explicit identity for the revealed figure. Rashi's explanation of הגם הלם concerns seeing messengers on earlier occasions too, but is not a direct lexical explanation of this Aramaic construction.

pairs.fullEnglish: And Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan, and Lot journeyed from the east; and they separated, each man from his brother.

qualifications.he: מִלְּקַדְמִין נמסרת כאן בהוראת מוצא מרחבית, 'מן המזרח', בצירוף לפועל הנסיעה ובהקשר של בחירת המישור והפרידה. אין פירושה כאן 'מזרחה'. רש״י על הפסוק העברי מפרש נסיעה ממזרח למערב; זו תמיכה הקשרית בקריאה, ולא פירוש מילוני מפורש למילה הארמית. דבריו על קדמונו של עולם אינם מתווספים לתרגום.
qualifications.en: מִלְּקַדְמִין is rendered here as a spatial point of departure, 'from the east,' with the travel verb and in the context of choosing the plain and separating. It is not rendered 'eastward.' Rashi on the Hebrew verse describes travel from east to west; this is contextual corroboration, not an explicit lexical gloss of the Aramaic word. His further interpretation concerning the Eternal One is not added to the translation.

qualifications.he: האנגלית משמרת ״איש מאחיו״. ב־12:5 לוט מוגדר בן אחיו של אברם; לשון ״אחיו״ כאן אינה קביעה נפרדת של אחווה ביולוגית.
qualifications.en: The English retains 'each man from his brother.' At 12:5 Lot is identified as Avrum's brother's son; 'his brother' here is not a separate assertion of biological brotherhood.

pairs.fullEnglish: And Avrum said: יְיָ אֱלֹּהִים, what will You give me, when I go on without a child? And this administrator who is in my house is the Damascene אֱלִיעֶזֶר.

qualifications.he: בַר פַּרְנָסָא מתורגם כאן כבעל תפקיד: הממונה על ניהול הבית ופרנסתו, ולא כקביעה על בן ביולוגי. רש״י אומר במפורש ״כתרגומו״ ומבאר ״שכל ביתי נזון על פיו״, ״אפוטרופוס שלי״; אחר כך הוא מבחין בין הממונה הקיים לבין בן שהיה יכול להיות ממונה אילו היה לאברם בן. זו תמיכה בפירוש הצירוף כתיאור תפקיד, בלי שינוי בנוסח התרגום או בניקודו. ההשוואה המקומית היא לשימוש פרטי ואינה מסירה מגבלות מקור וזכויות קיימות.
qualifications.en: בַר פַּרְנָסָא is rendered here as a role designation: the administrator responsible for the household and its maintenance, not an assertion of biological sonship. Rashi explicitly says 'as in the Targum' and explains 'my entire household is maintained at his direction' and 'my administrator'; he then distinguishes the existing officeholder from a son who could have held that office had Avrum had a son. This supports the compound's functional sense without changing the Targum's wording or pointing. The retained comparison is private-only and does not remove existing source or rights restrictions.

pairs.fullEnglish: Therefore he called the well: The well at which the angel of the Ever-living appeared. Behold, it is between רְקָם and חַגְרָא.

qualifications.he: מַלְאַךְ קַיָּמָא מתפרש כאן כסמיכות: ׳מלאכו של החי לעולם׳. קַיָּמָא מציין את בעל המלאך, ולא קביעה שהמלאך עצמו נצחי. אִתַּחֲזִי מתאר הופעה, ועֲלַהּ חוזר אל הבאר: הבאר שבה הופיע המלאך.
qualifications.en: מַלְאַךְ קַיָּמָא is read here as a construct chain, 'angel of the Ever-living'. קַיָּמָא designates the One whose angel he is, rather than asserting the angel's own eternity. אִתַּחֲזִי describes an appearance, and עֲלַהּ refers back to the well: the well at which the angel appeared.

qualifications.he: פועל הקריאה הוא בגוף זכר יחיד ואינו נוקב בשם הקורא. האנגלית שומרת ״הוא קרא״ ואינה מחליפה זאת בקביעה שהגר היא שקראה לבאר.
qualifications.en: The naming verb is masculine singular and does not name its agent. The English retains 'he called' rather than changing it to an assertion that Hagar named the well.

qualifications.he: ״הא״ מתורגם ״הנה״, ולפיכך האנגלית אומרת ״הנה, היא בין...״. החלופה שבסוגריים היא הכינוי ״היא״, כלומר ״היא בין...״ בלי ״הנה״. אין החלפה שקטה בין שתי הצורות.
qualifications.en: הָא is rendered 'behold,' giving 'Behold, it is between ...' in English. The parenthesized alternative הִיא is the pronoun 'it,' giving 'It is between ...' without 'behold.' The two forms are not silently interchanged.

pairs.fullEnglish: As for Me, behold, the decree of My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many peoples. The reading without the parenthesized word is: 'As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many peoples.'

qualifications.he: המקור מציג את גְזַר בסוגריים ומציין שבנוסחאות אחרות הוא חסר. בקריאה הכוללת אותו, גְזַר מוסר כאן שם עצם בסמיכות: גזרת בריתי; אין זו צורת פועל שפירושה ׳אני כורת׳. בלעדיו מתקבל המשפט ׳הנה בריתי עמך׳. שתי הקריאות נמסרות בנפרד, בלי לקבוע שהן נוסח אחד ובלי להוסיף מעשה חיתוך או מילה שאינו נאמר כאן.
qualifications.en: The source places גְזַר in parentheses and notes its absence in other versions. With that word, גְזַר is rendered here as a noun in construct: 'the decree of My covenant'; it is not treated as a first-person verb meaning 'I cut' or 'I make'. Without it the clause reads 'behold, My covenant is with you'. The two readings are given separately, without conflating them or adding an act of cutting or circumcision not stated here.

pairs.fullEnglish: Will they not be ashamed of their works? For the carpenter strengthens it together with the metalworker, the one striking with a hammer together with the one beating with a mallet. At one point he says of the join, 'It is sound,' and fastens it with nails so that it will not tilt.

qualifications.he: עִם מצרפת את בעלי המלאכה ואת שני תיאורי ההכאה: ׳יחד עם׳. זִמְנָא נמסרת כציון זמן לפני אֲמַר, ׳בשלב מסוים הוא אומר׳; אין בכך פירוט של סדר פעולות ההכאה או משכן. הדובר אינו מזוהה בשמו. דִבְקָא היא החיבור, בלי לקבוע אם נעשה בהלחמה או בטכניקה מסוימת אחרת; החיזוק במסמרים מפורש.
qualifications.en: עִם links the craftspeople and the two descriptions of striking: 'together with.' זִמְנָא is rendered as a time expression before אֲמַר, 'at one point he says'; this does not specify the order or duration of the hammering operations. The speaker is not identified by name. דִבְקָא is the join, without specifying soldering or another particular technique; fastening with nails is explicit.
qualifications.anchor: דְמַתְקֵיף נַגָרָא עִם קֵינָאָה מָחֵי בְּפַטִישָׁא עִם דִמְטַפַּח בְקוּרְנְסָא זִמְנָא אֲמַר עַל דִבְקָא תַּקִין הוּא

pairs.fullEnglish: It will be healing for your navel and nourishment for your bones.

qualifications.he: לְכוּנְשְׁרָךְ פירושו ׳לטבורך׳: המילון מציין במפורש את ההוראה ׳טבור׳ בשם הארמי כּוּנְשְׁרָא בפסוק זה. לאותו שם יש במילון גם הוראה של כלי טוויה בפסוק אחר; ההוראה כאן היא האיבר הגופני. וְדוּהֲנָא מציינת שמנונית או הזנה מעשירה לעצמות. לשון הרפואה וההזנה שבקטע אינה הוראה רפואית או ערובה מעשית לריפוי.
qualifications.en: לְכוּנְשְׁרָךְ means 'for your navel': the dictionary expressly gives the Aramaic noun כּוּנְשְׁרָא the sense 'navel' at this verse. The same dictionary noun also has a distaff sense at a different verse; the sense here is anatomical. וְדוּהֲנָא expresses fatness or enriching nourishment for the bones. The passage's healing and nourishment language is not medical instruction or a practical guarantee of cure.

pairs.fullEnglish: I will bring near their exiles from among the peoples and lead them along a well-ordered way. I will open rivers for them along the passes, and springs in the midst of encampments. I will make the wilderness into pools of water, and the parched land into springs of water.

qualifications.he: נַגְדִין מובנת כאן כדרכים או מעברים, שלאורכם נפתחים הנהרות. יסטרוב מציין את הפסוק הזה במפורש במשמעות זו, ומביא צורות רבים בניקוד שאינו זהה בכל פרטיו לניקוד שכאן. אין הכוונה בהכרח לגבהים או למעברי הרים; התיאור אינו מזהה מקום מסוים. הנהרות הם הדבר שנפתח, והמעברים מציינים את מקומם.
qualifications.en: נַגְדִין is understood here as paths or passes, along which the rivers are opened. Jastrow expressly cites this verse for that sense, while printing plural forms whose pointing is not identical in every detail to the form here. These need not be heights or mountain passes, and no particular locality is identified. The rivers are what is opened; the passes specify their location.

qualifications.he: מַשִׁרְיָן מובנת כאן כלשון מחנות או מקומות חניה, ובתוכם נפתחים המעיינות למען הגולים. לשון זו אינה קובעת שמדובר במחנות צבאיים. היא נבדלת מתיאור המעברים של הנהרות; אין התרגום אומר כאן שהמעיינות נמצאים בבקעות.
qualifications.en: מַשִׁרְיָן is understood here as encampments or camping places, within which the springs are opened for the exiles. The expression does not specify military camps. This is a different location description from the passes associated with the rivers; the Targum does not here say that the springs are in valleys.

dayTitle.en: The departure to the land and the blessing of Avrum

explanation.he: אברם יוצא על פי דבר יְיָ אל הארץ שיראה לו, ונאמר לו שכל משפחות הארץ יתברכו בגללו. התרגום מתאר את האנשים שבחרן כמי ששועבדו לתורה, ואת מקום מורה כמישור. בואו לארץ מתואר לצד נוכחות הכנעני בה.
explanation.en: Avrum departs at the word of יְיָ for the land that He will show him, and is told that all the families of the earth will be blessed on his account. The Targum describes the people in חָרָן as brought into service of the Torah, and describes the location of מוֹרֶה as a plain. His arrival in the land is set alongside the presence of the Canaanites there.

dayTitle.en: Revelation, prayer, and the descent to Egypt

explanation.he: יְיָ מתגלה לאברם ומבטיח את הארץ לבניו; אברם בונה שם מזבח לפניו. ליד בית אל הוא פורש את אוהלו, בונה מזבח ומתפלל בשם יְיָ. המסע דרומה נמשך, והרעב הכבד בארץ מביא לירידה למצרים כדי לשבת שם.
explanation.en: יְיָ is revealed to Avrum and promises the land to his children; Avrum builds an altar there before Him. Near Bais El he spreads his tent, builds an altar, and prays in the name of יְיָ. His journey south continues, and the severe famine in the land leads him down to Egypt to reside there.

dayTitle.en: Avrum's fear and Sarai's being taken

explanation.he: בקרבת מצרים אברם אומר לשרי שהוא חושש שיהרגו אותו וישאירו אותה בחיים. הוא מבקש שתאמר שהיא אחותו, והתרגום מייחס את שימור חייו לדבריה. המצרים רואים את יופייה, שרי פרעה משבחים אותה, והיא נלקחת לבית פרעה.
explanation.en: Near Egypt, Avrum tells Sarai that he fears they will kill him and keep her alive. He asks her to say that she is his sister, and the Targum connects the preservation of his life with her words. The Egyptians see her beauty, Pharaoh's officials praise her, and she is taken to Pharaoh's house.

dayTitle.en: Afflictions in Pharaoh's house and departure from Egypt

explanation.he: אברם מקבל רכוש ומקנה בגלל שרי, אך יְיָ מביא נגעים גדולים על פרעה ועל אנשי ביתו בגללה. פרעה שואל את אברם מדוע לא גילה שהיא אשתו, ומורה לו לקחת אותה וללכת. אנשים שקיבלו הוראות מפרעה מלווים את המשפחה ואת רכושה, ואברם עולה ממצרים דרומה עם שרי ולוט.
explanation.en: Avrum receives property and livestock on Sarai's account, but יְיָ brings great afflictions upon Pharaoh and his household because of her. Pharaoh asks Avrum why he did not disclose that she was his wife, and tells him to take her and go. Men instructed by Pharaoh escort the family and its property, and Avrum goes up from Egypt toward the south with Sarai and Lot.

dayTitle.en: Return to the altar and the abundance of possessions

explanation.he: אברם שב במסעותיו למקום האוהל והמזבח שבין בית אל לעי, ושם הוא מתפלל בשם יְיָ. התרגום מתאר את עושרו במקנה, בכסף ובזהב, ולצדו את המקנה והאוהלים של לוט. ריבוי רכושם מונע מן הארץ לשאת את ישיבתם יחד.
explanation.en: Avrum returns on his journeys to the place of the tent and altar between Bais El and עָי, and there he prays in the name of יְיָ. The Targum describes his wealth in livestock, silver, and gold, alongside Lot's livestock and tents. The abundance of their possessions prevents the land from sustaining their dwelling together.

dayTitle.he: פרידת לוט, הבטחת הארץ ומלחמת המלכים
dayTitle.en: Lot's separation, the promise of the land, and the war of the kings

explanation.he: בעקבות המריבה בין הרועים אברם מציע להיפרד, ולוט בוחר במישור הירדן המושקה ומתיישב עד סדום. יְיָ מבטיח לאברם את הארץ ולבניו ריבוי שאינו ניתן למניין; אברם מקים מזבח במישורי ממרא. התרגום מפרט את מלחמת המלכים, את השבי של לוט ואת יציאת אברם למרדף עם ילידי ביתו. אנשי סדום מתוארים כרעים בממונם וכחייבים בגופם לפני יְיָ.
explanation.en: After strife among the herdsmen, Avrum proposes separation, and Lot chooses the irrigated Jordan plain and settles as far as סְדוֹם. יְיָ promises Avrum the land and children too numerous to count; Avrum builds an altar in the plains of מַמְרֵא. The Targum details the war of the kings, Lot's captivity, and Avrum's pursuit with the men born in his household. The people of סְדוֹם are described as evil with their wealth and guilty with their bodies before יְיָ.

dayTitle.he: השבת השבויים, ברית הארץ וברית המילה
dayTitle.en: The return of the captives, the land covenant, and the covenant of circumcision

explanation.he: אברם משיב את השבויים והרכוש, מקבל ברכה ממלכי צדק ומסרב להתעשר מרכוש מלך סדום, תוך שמירת חלקם של האנשים שהלכו עמו. בנבואה נאמר שמימרו של יְיָ הוא תוקף לאברם, והוא נצטווה להקריב את בעלי החיים לקראת ברית הארץ וההודעה על שעבוד בניו ויציאתם ברכוש. הגר בורחת, מקבלת הוראה לשוב והבטחה לריבוי בניה, והתרגום מתאר את תפילתה ואת קבלת תפילתה בידי יְיָ. בהתגלות לאברם ניתנים השמות אברהם ושרה, ומובטחת הקמת הברית עם יצחק. נמסר ציווי המילה, ואברהם מל את הזכרים שבביתו באותו יום; הוא מתואר כשמח, וכבוד יְיָ מסתלק מעליו.
explanation.en: Avrum brings back the captives and possessions, receives a blessing from מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק, and refuses enrichment from the king of סְדוֹם while preserving the shares of the men who went with him. In prophecy he is told that the Word of יְיָ is strength for him, and is commanded to offer the animals in preparation for the land covenant and the announcement of his children's enslavement and departure with possessions. Hagar flees, receives a command to return and a promise of numerous children, and the Targum describes her prayer and its acceptance by יְיָ. In the revelation to Avrum, the names Avraham and Sarah are given, and the establishment of the covenant with יִצְחָק is promised. Circumcision is commanded, and Avraham circumcises the males of his household that day; he is described as rejoicing, and the glory of יְיָ ascends from above him.

dayTitle.he: תקווה באלהים בכל הלב ודרך ישרה
dayTitle.en: Wholehearted Hope in God and a Straight Path

explanation.he: הקריאה פותחת במציאת חן, שכל וטובה לפני אלהים ובני אדם. היא מצווה לקוות לאלהים בכל הלב, ולא להישען על הבנת הלב עצמו. ידיעת אלהים בכל הדרכים מצטרפת לאזהרה מפני חכמה בעיני עצמו ולציווי לירוא ממנו ולסור מן הרע.
explanation.en: The reading begins with finding favor, understanding, and goodwill before God and human beings. It calls for wholehearted hope in God rather than reliance on one’s own understanding. Knowing Him in every way is joined to a warning against self-assured wisdom and a call to fear God and turn away from evil.

dayTitle.he: המימר מסייע לשבטי יעקב ופיזור אויביהם
dayTitle.en: The Word Supports Jacob’s Tribes and Scatters Their Enemies

explanation.he: התרגום מבשר שהעמים המתגרין בישראל ואנשי מלחמתו יהיו כאין, בעוד יי מחזק את ימינו ומבטיח שהמימר בעזרו. הוא פונה במפורש אל שבטי בית יעקב וזרע ישראל, ומדמה אותם למורג חזק וחדש. פיזור האויבים מתואר באמצעות רוח ומימר, והחתימה היא שמחת ישראל במימר יי ותהילתו בקדוש ישראל.
explanation.en: The Targum declares that the peoples provoking Israel and making war against it will become nothing, while יְיָ strengthens Israel’s right hand and promises the Word’s support. It explicitly addresses the tribes of Jacob’s house and Israel’s offspring and likens them to a strong, new threshing sledge. Wind and the Word scatter their enemies, and the reading ends with Israel rejoicing in the Word of יְיָ and glorying in the Holy One of Israel.

dayTitle.he: צמאון ללימוד, קיבוץ גלויות ופריחת המדבר
dayTitle.en: Thirst for Instruction, Returning Exiles, and a Flourishing Wilderness

explanation.he: התרגום מדמה את הענווים והנצרכים המשתוקקים ללימוד לצמאים שאינם מוצאים מים, ומבטיח קבלת תפילתם ואי־הרחקתם. קיבוץ הגלויות והנהגתן בדרך מתוקנת מצטרפים לפתיחת נהרות ומעיינות ולצמיחת עצים במדבר ובמישור. מטרת המראות היא הכרה בגבורת יי ויראתו בלב, ולבסוף נשמעת קריאה להביא את הדין ואת הדברים המוצגים לפני מלך יעקב.
explanation.en: The Targum compares humble, needy people longing for instruction to those unable to find water, and promises that their prayer will be received and that they will not be put far away. Returning exiles and their guidance along a well-ordered way accompany rivers, springs, and trees growing in the wilderness and plain. These sights lead to recognition of the might of יְיָ and fear of Him in the heart; the reading then calls for a case and its supporting presentation before the King of Jacob.

dayTitle.en: Creation’s Wisdom and Preserving Knowledge on the Way

explanation.he: התרגום תולה את ייסוד הארץ ואת כינון השמים בחכמה ובהבנה, ואת בקיעת התהומות בדעת אלהים. לאחר תיאור הטל מן השמים באה קריאה לשמור דעת ומחשבה. אלה מתוארים כחיים לנפש וכחן לצוואר, והחתימה מתארת הליכה בתקווה ללא מכשול לרגל.
explanation.en: The Targum attributes the founding of the earth and the establishment of the heavens to wisdom and understanding, and the splitting of the depths to God’s knowledge. The description of dew from the heavens is followed by a call to preserve knowledge and thought. These are described as life for the soul and grace for the neck, ending with a picture of walking in hope without stumbling.

dayTitle.en: Righteous Paths and Kindness and Truth in the Heart

explanation.he: הקריאה מצווה ללכת בדרכי הטובים ולשמור את שבילי הצדיקים, ומנגידה את הישארות הישרים בארץ לעקירת הרשעים והבוזזים. בהמשך הפנייה 'בני' מלווה באזהרה שלא לשכוח את תורת הדובר ובקריאה לשמור את מצוותיו בלב. חסד ואמת מתוארים כדברים שיש לקשור על הצוואר ולכתוב על לוח הלב.
explanation.en: The reading calls for walking in the ways of good people and keeping righteous paths, contrasting the upright who remain in the land with the wicked and plunderers who are removed. The address 'My son' then introduces a warning not to forget the speaker's teaching and a call to keep his commandments in the heart. Kindness and truth are to be bound around the neck and written on the heart's tablet.

dayTitle.en: Honoring God and Receiving His Discipline

explanation.he: הקריאה מתארת רפואה והזנה בלשון המתייחסת לגוף, וקוראת לכבד את אלהים מן הממון ומראשית היבול. היא מציירת מחסנים מלאים ויקבים שופעי יין. לבסוף היא מזהירה שלא לבוז למוסר אלהים ושלא למאוס בתוכחתו, ומסבירה שאלהים מייסר את מי שהוא אוהב, כאב המייסר את בנו.
explanation.en: The reading describes healing and nourishment in bodily language and calls for honoring God from one's wealth and the first of one's produce. It depicts full storehouses and presses overflowing with wine. It then warns against despising God's discipline or loathing His rebuke, explaining that God disciplines the one He loves as a father disciplines his son.

dayTitle.en: Abraham, Chosen of the Righteous, and the One Who Orders Generations

explanation.he: התרגום מזהה במפורש את מי שהובא בגלוי ממזרח כאברהם בחיר הצדיקים, ומתאר עמים שנמסרו לפניו ומלכים תקיפים שנשברו. הוא מדגיש את מעברו בשלום ואת לאות הדרך שלא נכנסה לרגליו. יי מכריז שהוא בורא העולם ומסדר הדורות, והאיים וקצות הארץ מגיבים בפחד ובהתקרבות.
explanation.en: The Targum explicitly identifies the one brought openly from the east as Abraham, chosen of the righteous, and describes peoples delivered before him and mighty kings shattered. It emphasizes his peaceful passage and the weariness of the road that did not enter his feet. יְיָ declares Himself the world's Creator and the One who orders generations, while the islands and those at the earth's ends respond with fear and approach.

dayTitle.he: מעלת החכמה ועץ החיים לעוסקים בה
dayTitle.en: Wisdom’s Worth and the Tree of Life for Those Engaged in It

explanation.he: התרגום משבח את מוצא החכמה ואת המביא לידי ביטוי הבנה, ומעדיף את מסחר החכמה ותנובתה על כסף וזהב מזוקק. הוא מתאר את החכמה כיקרה מאבנים טובות, ואת דרכיה כנוחות ושלוות. היא עץ חיים למחזיקים בה, ואושרם של העוסקים בה נזכר במפורש.
explanation.en: The Targum praises the person who finds wisdom and the person who brings forth understanding, valuing wisdom's trade and yield above silver and refined gold. Wisdom surpasses precious stones, and its ways are pleasantness and peace. It is a tree of life for those who hold fast to it, and the happiness of those who occupy themselves with it is stated explicitly.

dayTitle.he: חידוש כוחם של המייחלים לישועת יי
dayTitle.en: Renewed Strength for Those Awaiting Divine Deliverance

explanation.he: התרגום משיב לטענת ישראל שדרכם נסתרת מלפני יי ושדינם עובר מלפני אלהיהם, ומעמיד מולה את חכמת הבורא שאין לה סוף. הוא מתאר נתינת חכמה לצדיקים בזיקה לדברי תורה ותוספת נכסים לחסרי כוח, ובהמשך את קיבוץ המייחלים לישועת יי מתוך גלותם ואת חידוש נעוריהם. הקריאה מסתיימת בזימון האיים והמלכויות לשמוע את המימר ולהתקרב למשפט.
explanation.en: The Targum answers Israel's claim that their way is hidden from before יְיָ and their judgment passes from before their God, setting against it the Creator's limitless understanding. It describes wisdom given to the righteous in connection with the words of Torah and increased possessions for those without strength, followed by the gathering of those awaiting Divine deliverance from their exile and the renewal of their youth. The reading closes by summoning islands and kingdoms to listen to the Word and approach judgment.

dayTitle.he: עבודת בעלי המלאכה ובחירת ישראל עבדו
dayTitle.en: The Craftsmen’s Work and Israel, the Chosen Servant

explanation.he: התרגום מתאר אנשים המסייעים זה לזה ובעלי מלאכה המחזקים את מעשה ידיהם במסמרים, ושואל אם לא יבושו במעשיהם. כנגד זאת ישראל נקרא עבדו של אלהים וזרעו של אברהם אהובו, ונזכרים קירובו ובחירתו ואי־הרחקתו. הוא נקרא שלא לפחד ושלא להישבר, משום שהמימר בעזרו ואלהים מחזק אותו, מסייע לו ואוחז בו בימין אמיתו.
explanation.en: The Targum describes people helping one another and craftspeople fastening their handiwork with nails, and asks whether they will not be ashamed of their works. Israel, by contrast, is addressed as God's servant and the offspring of His beloved Abraham; being brought near, chosen, and not put far away are recalled. Israel is told not to fear or be broken, for the Word is its support and God strengthens, helps, and upholds it with His right hand of truth.
